title: Creating a derived QoS rule by reflective QoS in the UE

entities.name: Derived QoS Rule Creation
entities.description: Procedure where the UE creates a new derived QoS rule when receiving a DL user data packet with QFI and RQI, under specified conditions.

entities.name: DL User Data Packet
entities.description: Downlink user data packet marked with QFI and RQI that triggers the creation of a derived QoS rule.

entities.name: QoS Flow Identifier
entities.description: Identifier for the QoS flow, set in the derived QoS rule from the received QFI.

entities.name: Reflective QoS Indication
entities.description: Indication in the DL packet that reflective QoS is applied.

entities.name: Derived QoS Rule
entities.description: QoS rule created by the UE with QFI, precedence value 80, and derived UL packet filter.

entities.name: Precedence Value 80
entities.description: Fixed precedence value set to 80 for the derived QoS rule.

entities.name: UL Packet Filter
entities.description: Packet filter for uplink direction derived from the DL user data packet.

entities.name: Timer T3583
entities.description: Timer associated with the derived QoS rule, started with the RQ timer value.

entities.name: RQ Timer Value
entities.description: Timer value received during PDU session procedures or using default standardized value.

entities.name: No Existing Derived QoS Rule Condition
entities.description: Condition that no derived QoS rule with the same UL packet filter exists.

entities.name: PDU Session Type Condition
entities.description: Condition that the PDU session is of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, or Ethernet type.

relations.description: Creation of derived QoS rule is triggered by receiving a DL user data packet with QFI and RQI.
Procedure requires that no existing derived QoS rule with same UL packet filter is present.
Procedure requires the PDU session to be of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, or Ethernet type.
Procedure establishes a new derived QoS rule.
Derived QoS rule contains the QFI set from the received QFI.
Derived QoS rule contains the precedence value set to 80.
Derived QoS rule contains the derived UL packet filter.
Procedure starts timer T3583 associated with the derived QoS rule.
Timer T3583 uses the RQ timer value from PDU session procedures or default value.
